title: Bag Pre-Check
claims: 纽约马拉松存包需提前选择，预存包在比赛前一天 17:00 关闭。
完赛后可在中央公园西侧 73–75 街领取，至 19:00；之后转至 NYRR RUNCENTER。
The page describes the current New York City Marathon bag-check rules, deadlines and pickup location; it does not state that these apply to other races.
